assessment_metadata.title: Authoritative ARX Radar Universe Readiness Assessment (Issue #166)
assessment_metadata.production_authority_rationale: The relationship between the inspected store (/Users/iDavid/.finance_market_store.db, 61 symbols, 7951 daily bars) and the earlier reported baseline store containing 585 symbols and 228,937 bars cannot be established from available local artifacts. Live production queries were not executed in strict observance of operational boundaries and SEC trial isolation. Therefore, production authority is marked NOT_CHECKED.

blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.finding: In the inspected store, 445 candidate symbols have 0 bars (MISSING_MARKET_DATA), 55 have insufficient 200 SMA history, and 0 have insufficient slope history. Only 0 symbols satisfy the 200 SMA threshold.
blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.scope_limitation: Finding applies strictly to inspected store (/Users/iDavid/.finance_market_store.db). Production market store authority is NOT_CHECKED.
blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.historical_claim_status: The historical '439/500 stale' claim from prior status reports remains an unverified historical measurement whose calculation basis is not established by local artifacts.
blocker_1_market_data_deficit_in_local_s.next_dependency: An attributable, consistent export of the actual production Radar stores.

blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.finding: In the inspected store, asset_ohlcv_provenance contains 0 rows. 500 of 500 candidate symbols lack table-level provenance.
blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.scope_limitation: Finding applies strictly to inspected store. Production provenance authority is NOT_CHECKED.
blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.historical_claim_status: The historical '67 symbols lacked provenance' claim remains an unverified historical figure whose specific symbol roster cannot be confirmed from local artifacts.
blocker_2_provenance_deficit_in_local_st.next_dependency: An attributable, consistent export of the actual production Radar stores.

blocker_3_snapshot_compatibility_and_cod.finding: Under the publication integrity contract (ScannerPublicationIntegrityEngine), snapshot compatibility is governed by the 6-component ScannerVersionTuple, component content hashes, and semantic fingerprint, rather than git commit SHAs alone. Different commit SHAs alone across non-functional PRs do not establish incompatibility. However, the inspected scanner store contains 1 snapshots (0 VCP snapshots). Local snapshot compatibility cannot be established.
blocker_3_snapshot_compatibility_and_cod.scope_limitation: Production snapshot serving state is NOT_CHECKED.
blocker_3_snapshot_compatibility_and_cod.next_dependency: An attributable, consistent export of the actual production Radar stores.
